passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Authorities initially considered whether Jennifer could have escaped or hidden during the shootings. After searches around the property failed to locate her, investigators increasingly believed she had been abducted by the person or persons responsible for killing her parents.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Officers and search teams scoured the area surrounding the Short home.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The discovery created two investigations simultaneously:

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Jennifer Is Missing: After finding Michael and Mary, officers discovered that their 9-year-old daughter, Jennifer Renee Short, was missing.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Michael Short had been shot once in the head. A.22-caliber shell casing was recovered near Michael.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Mary Short had been shot once in the head. A second.22-caliber shell casing was recovered near Mary.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The telephone line to the home had been cut.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Jennifer was missing.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Investigators began processing the residence for fingerprints, biological material, firearms evidence, and other trace evidence.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Crime Scene and Initial Search: Investigators secured the Short property

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Investigators began an intensive search around the residence and the surrounding Henry County area. Investigators searched wooded terrain, roads, structures, and other areas where Jennifer might have gone if she had fled.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Search-and-rescue personnel and volunteers eventually became involved.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: 4:25 p.m. An alert for Jennifer was distributed through the developing AMBER Alert system. Jennifer’s disappearance received widespread regional and eventually national attention.

passages.text: According to the October 5 report, Bowman had done odd jobs for Lemons and for Gary Lemons, Lemons’ landlord.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Bowman reportedly worked on mobile homes in the area and was described as a carpenter.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Same Day: Bowman’s landlord, Rick Lemons, later reported that Bowman made a telephone call concerning killing a man in Virginia whom he said had failed to pay him for trailer work.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The physical search continued. Investigators worked to reconstruct the Shorts’ movements before the murders and determine who had recently interacted with the family. The working theory remained that Jennifer could still be alive.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Bowman traveled north and ultimately entered Canada.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: His departure would later receive intense scrutiny after Jennifer’s remains were discovered near property associated with him.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: At this point, however, Bowman had not been publicly connected to the Short murders.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Garrison Bowman Leaves North Carolina: Neighbors later told investigators that Garrison “Gary” Bowman, a 66-year-old carpenter from Rockingham County, North Carolina, left the area on August 16, the day after the Short family crime was discovered.
